verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant that reaches the user's data through connected integrations and answers in natural conversation (docs-7, docs-19). It reads and searches email, checks calendar availability (docs-23, docs-24), and builds tables and charts from user-described or uploaded data (docs-21). It is also described as proactive (probe-1), which implies it surfaces suggestions on its own. missing for 10: explicit documentation of proactive insight or suggestion generation from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
